entrypoint: python3 -m pip install -q 'ray[default]' && ray start --head --node-ip-address='10.0.0.1' --port='6379' --dashboard-host=0.0.0.0 --object-store-memory='4294967296' --temp-dir='/mnt/ray/leanstral-vllm' && until ray status ... (2 active nodes); do sleep 3; done && vllm serve ...
setup: Each container pip-installs ray[default] at start (the image lacks the Ray CLI), so both nodes need internet. Head container runs Ray head, waits for 2 active nodes, then vllm serve. Worker (over SSH to 10.0.0.2) runs 'ray start --node-ip-address=10.0.0.2 --address=10.0.0.1:6379 --object-store-memory=4294967296 --temp-dir=/tmp/ray --block' with VLLM_HOST_IP=10.0.0.2, RAY_TMPDIR=/tmp/ray and spill dir /mnt/spark1/ray/leanstral-vllm-spill, no RAY_ADDRESS. Host dirs /mnt/ray/leanstral-vllm and /mnt/ray/leanstral-vllm-spill are bind-mounted at the same paths. HF caches: head /home/zurih/.cache/huggingface, worker WORKER_HF_HOME (default /mnt/spark1/models/.cache/huggingface); weights download on first start from inside each container. Passwordless SSH to the worker.
